Here are your answers, fresh and non-repetitive, with a touch of Telegram flair! ✨

Your body's physiology simply won't allow you to do both simultaneously, making it a fascinating and surprisingly tough impossibility that people often don't consider! 🧠😮

2- **Loss Aversion** is a powerful psychological insight explaining our tendency to **feel the pain of a loss much more intensely than the pleasure of an equivalent gain.** 📉💔📈 For example, most people would rather avoid losing $50 than gaining $50. Understanding this is incredibly useful: it sheds light on why we cling to investments even when they're failing, resist change even when it's beneficial, or make cautious decisions. It helps us recognize biases in our financial choices, negotiations, and willingness to take risks, encouraging a more rational perspective on gains and losses! 💡💰⚖️

«این جهان کوه است و فعل ما ندا
سوی ما آید نداها را صدا» ⛰️🗣️ ECHO
(Īn jahān kūh ast o fe'l-e mā nedā
Soy-e mā āyad nedā-hā rā sedā)
(This world is a mountain, and our action is the call;
The echoes of the calls come back to us.)
**Poet:** Rumi (مولانا جلال‌الدین محمد بلخی) - the revered 13th-century Persian poet and Sufi mystic, whose profound verses often explore themes of karma, resonance, and the reflection of our deeds. This beautiful couplet emphasizes that our actions and intentions ripple outwards and eventually return to us. 📜✨

It encourages us to engage more deeply with tasks and appreciate the value that effort adds! 🎨🌟

Bī khabar az now shodan andar baqā)
(Every moment the world is renewed, and we
Are unaware of its renewal, remaining in perpetuity.)
